to separate lines. Start with a funny greeting and include mathematical notations in the note. At the end of your response, explicitly add a postscript starting with P.P.S

trace.content:
Dear McQueen,
You're a real speed demon, aren't you?
I've calculated your chances of winning the next racing competition, and I've got the formula: P(Win) = (Your Speed x Your Skill) / (Your Competitors' Speed x Their Skill) + (Your Car's Coolness x Your Attitude).
Plugging in the numbers, I get: P(Win) = (1000 x 10) / (500 x 5) + (10 x 10) = 20 + 100 = 120%.
That's a 20% chance of winning, plus a 100% chance of looking cool doing it.
So, I'd say you've got this in the bag... or should I say, in the gas tank?
Good luck, and may the fastest car win! P.P.S. Don't forget to fill up on gas before the competition, or you'll be left in the dust!
